data.name: Subspace: Redux
data.detailed_description:
Fast, Fair, Serverless Space Combat

Subspace: Redux is a spiritual successor to the classic multiplayer dogfighting of

Subspace/Continuum — rebuilt from the ground up with zero server costs and zero

subscriptions. Every match runs peer-to-peer over Steam. No dedicated servers to shut down,

no live-service sunset. Buy it once, play it forever.

Fly Your Way

Choose from 16 distinct hulls, each a genuine sidegrade — not a stat upgrade. Warbird,

Javelin, Spider, and five more are free from the start. Eight premium ships, ranging from

Rare to Singularity rarity, add new handling and weapon characteristics to master, never a

raw power advantage over free pilots.

Premium is cosmetic and sidegrade only — this is not a pay-to-win game.

Loot, Bounty, and a Galaxy Worth Exploring

  • Rarity-tiered loot upgrades eight independent ship systems — guns, bombs, mines,

  • engines, thrusters, armour, shields, and reactor — from Common all the way to Singularity.

  • Earn Bounty in combat and track your progress toward over 160 Steam achievements.

  • Travel a quadrant-linked galaxy through jump gates, from safe zones to contested

  • territory.

  • Form a squad of up to five pilots and take on the frontier together.

Built on Steam, For Players

Steam handles matchmaking presence, achievements, and friend invites — there's no separate

account, no launcher, no always-online requirement beyond Steam itself. Your progress, your

ships, your galaxy.

data.short_description: Fast-paced multiplayer space combat inspired by the classic Subspace. Pick from 16 distinct ships, loot rare equipment, earn bounty in dogfights, and explore a jump-gate-linked galaxy with your squad. No pay-to-win, ever.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 (6th gen) / AMD Ryzen 3, or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel UHD 620 / integrated graphics with WebGL 2.0 support, or NVIDIA GTX 750 / AMD equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 50 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7 (8th gen+) / AMD Ryzen 5, or equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD RX 580 or better (4GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 50 MB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 12 Monterey or later
  • Processor: Apple M1, or Intel Core i5 (2018 or later)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M1 integrated GPU, or Intel UHD 630 / AMD Radeon Pro 555X (WebGL 2.0 required)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 50 MB available space
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 13 Ventura or later
  • Processor: Apple M2 or later, or Intel Core i7 (2019 or later)
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M2 integrated GPU or better, or AMD Radeon Pro 5500M
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 50 MB available space

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: 20.04 LTS or later / SteamOS 3.0+
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 (6th gen) / AMD Ryzen 3, or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Mesa-compatible GPU with OpenGL 4.1+ / Vulkan support (Intel UHD 620 or better, NVIDIA GTX 750 or better, AMD equivalent)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 50 MB available space
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS or later / SteamOS 3.0+
  • Processor: Intel Core i7 (8th gen+) / AMD Ryzen 5, or equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD RX 580 or better (4GB VRAM), proprietary
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 50 MB available space
